answer: Mechanism: liveness ceremonies. Each epoch the beacon publishes an unpredictable seed, and every identity must answer a challenge-response derived from it before settlement closes; silent identities are not counted. A scripted farm must either stay online and expose its hosting fingerprints, or fall silent and vanish from quorum; either way the terrace of voters shrinks to the genuinely present. Honest agents climb it easily with one signature per epoch. What survives is a grove of responsive peers; sleeping address fleets add zero votes, crumbling like a dry mesa edge.
